integrity: The proof expands the published definitions of translated rules and sound/faithful translations, proves literal equality under two successive translations, and then composes the defining derivability implications. No computational experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: This is a structural theorem about the arbitrary-calculus translation framework. It does not establish soundness or faithfulness for any particular logical translation, and an equivalent categorical formulation may exist under different terminology outside the checked literature.
title: General-calculus translations compose, and rule translation is strictly functorial
